name: Project Portfolio Tracker
description: Cross-department project status, budget, and delivery metrics

executiveSummary.overview: 20 active projects across 6 departments represent $4.41M in combined budget. 7 projects are complete, 10 are in progress, and 3 are in planning. Average project completion rate is 69% against an average budget consumption of 71%.
executiveSummary.topCategory: Engineering carries the highest portfolio risk with 5 concurrent projects totaling $1.67M — including 3 Critical-priority items. The Mobile App v2 and Data Platform Upgrade are both over 88% spent and near completion.
executiveSummary.risk: ERP Migration is in early planning at only 12% complete with $620K budget — the largest single project risk if scope changes emerge. Mobile App v2 has consumed 95% of budget at 94% completion — minimal buffer remains.
executiveSummary.opportunities: 7 completed projects achieved an average of 97% budget efficiency. Applying their delivery methodology to the 3 planning-stage projects could reduce estimated overruns by $45-80K.
executiveSummary.recommendation: Escalate ERP Migration planning review — at current pace, detailed design should begin immediately to protect the Q4 2025 deadline. Establish weekly checkpoints for Mobile App v2 to manage final 6% delivery risk.

smartAlerts.description: ERP Migration at $620K is 2.8x above the average project budget — flag for portfolio review.

smartAlerts.title: Status Dominance

aiInsights.text: Mobile App v2 has consumed 95% of its $520K budget at 94% progress — extremely thin buffer. Any scope addition will require immediate budget amendment.
ERP Migration at 12% progress with 7% budget consumed is on track for planning phase, but the Q4 2025 deadline requires accelerating design phase by 6 weeks.
Completed projects show strong budget discipline (avg 97% efficiency) — Engineering and Finance teams demonstrate delivery excellence worth replicating.
3 Critical-priority Engineering projects running concurrently may cause resource contention — consider staggering delivery timelines by 4-6 weeks.
HR projects (AI Hiring Tool, Learning Platform) show strong ROI potential — both are on track with healthy spend-to-progress ratios.
